test_gpu_index_serialization: test GPU index serialization by serializing to CPU and deserializing back to GPU for Flat, IVFFlat, IVFSQ, and IVFPQ index types
create_gpu_index_flat: create a GpuIndexFlatL2 index using StandardGpuResources and a specified dimension for exact nearest neighbor search
create_gpu_index_ivfflat: create a GpuIndexIVFFlat index with configurable nlist and L2 metric for inverted file indexing on GPU
create_gpu_index_ivfsq: create a GpuIndexIVFScalarQuantizer index with fp16 scalar quantization and configurable cuvs support
create_gpu_index_ivfpq: create a GpuIndexIVFPQ index with product quantization using specified subquantizers and bits per subquantizer
